_description: Multiple before_tax income events taxed as aggregate. Tests that only one standard deduction applies.
_rationale: Single filer, Florida, two pensions of $20k each (before_tax) at age 62. Combined gross = $40k. Standard deduction (2026 single) = $16,100. Taxable = $23,900. Federal tax = $1,240 (10% on $12,400) + $1,380 (12% on $11,500) = $2,620. Net = $37,380/yr.
name: Aggregate Tax
